title: Draft: various improvements to the possibly-compressed-file writing code.
description:
Various improvements to the possibly-compressed-file writing code.
    
Have libwiretap usertap use the ws_cwstream routines rather than
reimplementing what those routines do. Make the internal routines to
handle writing particular compression formats static.

Have those provide err_info strings for certain errors and have them
percolate up through libwiretap; this means that more of those routines
provide err_info strings. Update callers to use that information.

For now, map FILE_ERR_ error codes to WTAP_ERR_ error codes in
libwiretap. Ultimately, we should probably have FILE_ERR_ codes and
WTAP_ERR_ codes not overlap, and have libwiretap routines return both,
along with errnos.

Fix some error reporting to properly show the error and, if present,
additional error information.

Make some static buffers for error messages thread-local.

AI-Assisted: no

commits_data.title: Various improvements to the possibly-compressed-file writing code.
commits_data.message:
Various improvements to the possibly-compressed-file writing code.

Have libwiretap usertap use the ws_cwstream routines rather than
reimplementing what those routines do. Make the internal routines to
handle writing particular compression formats static.

Have those provide err_info strings for certain errors and have them
percolate up through libwiretap; this means that more of those routines
provide err_info strings. Update callers to use that information.

For now, map FILE_ERR_ error codes to WTAP_ERR_ error codes in
libwiretap. Ultimately, we should probably have FILE_ERR_ codes and
WTAP_ERR_ codes not overlap, and have libwiretap routines return both,
along with errnos.

Fix some error reporting to properly show the error and, if present,
additional error information.

Make some static buffers for error messages thread-local.

AI-Assisted: no
